rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.withhold_reason: Withheld: the twin keys NPH and NPH.JO are one issuer but published different figures for the same period. Neither key is backed by the issuer's own filing, so nothing on file settles which is right and both sides are withheld.
rows.withheldReason: Operating Expenses withheld: the audited consolidated statement of profit or loss presents no operating expenses line outside cost of sales. Operating costs, concentrates purchased, refining and other costs, depreciation and the metal inventory movement all sit inside cost of sales. The stored row carried figures that do not appear in that statement (R80.9m of operating expenses against R54.0bn of revenue for F2026). Operating profit as printed equals gross profit.

notes: The issuer statement of profit or loss (results presentation, statement of profit or loss) carries no operating expenses line: Revenue less Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit, which the group reports as operating profit. Operating Expenses is therefore empty for FY2026 and FY2025.

Profit Before Tax exceeds Operating Profit because it includes a R2,526.9m reversal of impairment, R1,091.8m investment income and R1,034.4m sundry income, less R1,343.9m finance charges and R222.0m sundry expenditure.
note: Operating Expenses withheld: the audited consolidated statement of profit or loss presents no operating expenses line outside cost of sales.
